title: LGIM策略师：财政部管不了利率，但能管曲线，10s30s做平策略
speaker: Ben Bennett

segments.en: So I break it down into two things. One is that the treasury cannot control the level of interest rates, I mean that's the short end, that's of course, that's the Federal Reserve, but they can control the curve shape.
segments.zh: 我把它分成两点。一是财政部无法控制利率水平，短期利率当然由美联储决定，但他们可以控制曲线形态。

segments.en: So I mean, the Scott Besson could decide not to issue any more 30-year bonds and buy them all back, and then he's fully controlled part of the curve. So from our perspective, he said that the curve is now too steep, he wants it to be if anything a bit flatter.
segments.zh: 比如斯科特·贝森可以决定不再发行30年期国债并全部买回，这样他就完全控制了曲线的一部分。所以从我们的角度看，他说曲线现在太陡，他希望更平一些。

segments.en: So we've put curve flattener trays on 10s, 30s, because that's what he's told us, but he's not going to control the actual level of the curve. So yields, I think, under what we've heard from Kevin Warsh, yields have gone up a little bit to start off with.
segments.zh: 所以我们在10年期和30年期上做了曲线趋平交易，因为他已经告诉我们了，但他不会控制曲线的实际水平。所以收益率，我认为，在凯文·沃什的讲话后，收益率起初有所上升。

segments.en: But also, have you seen that the curve is flattened on the back of what he said as well? Because he's putting in some sensible policies that take out a bit of the term premium, I think. So that's also going in the same direction as Scott Besson.
segments.zh: 但你也看到，曲线因为他的讲话而变平了？因为他推出了一些合理的政策，消除了部分期限溢价。所以这也和斯科特·贝森的方向一致。

segments.en: OK, so maybe some fed credibility has been restored a little bit. So you're more comfortable going maybe longer duration.
segments.zh: 好的，所以也许美联储的信誉有所恢复。所以你可能更倾向于拉长久期。
